title: Localized strict-transform chart comparison
statement:
Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $a\in I$, $b$ the image of $a$ in $B$, and $J=IB$. Write $R=C_a^{\mathrm{st}}(A,B,I)$, $T=B[J/b]$, and $f=\overline\sigma_a:R\to T$ for [def-nagata-strict-transform-chart-comparison]. Localizations at one element have the meaning of [def-weil-ring-localization-away].

For a chart element $c\in R$, define the localized comparison
$$f_c:R_c\longrightarrow T_{f(c)},\qquad \frac{z}{c^n}\longmapsto\frac{f(z)}{f(c)^n}.$$
Precisely, this is the unique extension of $R\xrightarrow{f}T\to T_{f(c)}$ supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-localization-away-universal-property]. If $s\in B$ (or $s\in A$), take $c$ to be its structural image in $R$ and denote this map by $(\overline\sigma_a)_s$; the denominator in the target is the structural image of the same $s$.

When the localized source and target are written in canonically isomorphic tensor-product or iterated-localization presentations, with isomorphisms $\alpha:R_c\xrightarrow{\sim}R'$ and $\beta:T_{f(c)}\xrightarrow{\sim}T'$, the notation means the transported homomorphism $\beta\circ f_c\circ\alpha^{-1}$. The tensor-localization identifications are those of [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-localization-away-base-change], with formula $(x/s^n)\otimes y\mapsto(x\otimes y)/(s\otimes1)^n$ (or the exchanged tensor factors). The iterated-localization identifications are the unique isomorphisms over the original ring from [lem-weil-pbc-localization-of-localization] and the localization universal property; for elements $s,t$ of a ring $E$, the identifications of $(E_s)_{t/1}$ and $(E_t)_{s/1}$ send an iterated fraction to $z\,s^{-m}t^{-n}$ in $E_{st}$.

blueprint_notes.label: status
blueprint_notes.text:
**Status.** Bypassed by the formalized route: the strict transform is
supplied by the API of
`WeilConjectures/Compactification/StrictTransform.lean` —
`AlgebraicGeometry.strictTransform`, its closed immersion
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isClosedImmersion_pullbackLift_blowup_comap`,
and the pullback square
`AlgebraicGeometry.isPullback_strictTransformOpen` — so the
strict-transform chart rings and their cocycle are never assembled by hand.

blueprint_update.statement:
After localizing the base ring or a chart ring, define
$(\overline\sigma_a)_s$ by localizing the source and target of
$\overline\sigma_a$ and transporting along the canonical tensor-product
and iterated-localization associativity maps.

split_report.summary: Q129: expanded the current blueprint definition into its typed source and target, fraction formula, and explicit conjugation by the canonical presentation isomorphisms. Reused the existing comparison definition and four localization/tensor tools; no new nodes and no proof obligations hidden inside a definition. The tagged Lean definition covers only localization at s in B with values in the ambient localization, so is not an exact attachment.
split_report.blueprint: Current snapshot main-20261015, order 160: localizing source and target gives f_c; base-ring elements are inserted via structural maps; transport along tensor-product and iterated-localization associativity maps is beta composed with f_c composed with alpha inverse.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q129-befd82c24 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item in full: a definition split with 0 new nodes and 5 stmt_deps. It matches the main-20261015 definition (order 160): f_c sends z/c^n to f(z)/f(c)^n from R_c to T_{f(c)}. The map comes from lem-weil-pbc-localization-away-universal-property (Stacks 00CP), and f(c)/1 is a unit, so it exists. Base elements of A or B enter as their structural images. This is correct because sigma_a(y⊗1)=y, so the comparison is a B-algebra map. The transport is beta∘f_c∘alpha^{-1}. The tensor identification comes from lem-weil-pbc-algebra-localization-away-base-change (00DK/00DL), and the formula matches that node. The iterated-localization identification (E_s)_{t/1} ≅ E_{st} is unique over E, and the image z s^-m t^-n is correct. Identifying R_s with C^st(A,B_s,I) is left to lemma-nagata-strict-transform-chart-localization(-data), which cite this item, so there is no cycle. Nothing was weakened, and the route of unit sk-lem-nagata-sketch-blowups (step 1, 'commute with localization') is unchanged. Small cases checked: Z with I=(2), k[x,y]/(y) on the x-chart (R=T=k[x]), f(c)=0, c=0, c=1, and Z[1/6]. The Mathlib searches cover all three kinds. Localization.awayMap is the generic core of f_c, but the blow-up comparison f is not in Mathlib, so status split is right. B10: slopmaster2 has no declaration for this id. The live strictChartComparisonAway (StrictTransformChart.lean:565) handles only s∈B and lands in (B_s)_{b'}, so it is not exact and was rightly not attached. The item is not on the dropped list and is unsplit on live and side-live. Minor: the report says source now names order 160, but the JSON still names the master copy (order 152). The defining sentence is identical there, so I made no fix.
